sources_considered.why: Read to verify context; not used as evidence of the claim's truth.
Contemporaneous experiments provide a plausible route to better reasoning and explicitly describe the limits of extrapolation.
The May version tests predictions of capabilities across existing models; later revisions were excluded.
Provides a contemporaneous caution about interpreting apparent capability jumps.
Tree of Thoughts reports substantial task-specific gains, but these were already demonstrated before the post and do not independently establish gains beyond its unspecified current baseline.
Architectural limits on particular mathematical tasks do not establish a general absence of further capability gains.
The retrieved text did not provide enough methodological detail to separate transformer capabilities from the combined system.

evidence_items.locator: Section 5.1, Downstream Performance; see also Section 7, Limitations
evidence_items.explanation: The paper reports reasoning improvements from training Mistral 7B to generate internal rationales, including an increase from 36.3% to 47.2% on CommonsenseQA. This is a plausible sign of further headroom, but the authors had tested only a seven-billion-parameter model and had not established the benefit at the contemporary frontier.

evidence_items.publisher: arXiv; Yangjun Ruan, Chris J. Maddison, and Tatsunori Hashimoto
evidence_items.locator: Section 1, Agentic capabilities; validation qualification immediately before the contribution summaries
evidence_items.explanation: Successful predictions across existing models provide an empirical basis for investigating further scaling. The authors explicitly distinguish validation on existing models from predictions awaiting tests on future models; this does not establish substantial gains beyond the July baseline.

evidence_items.publisher: arXiv; Rylan Schaeffer, Brando Miranda, and Sanmi Koyejo
evidence_items.locator: Section 2, Alternative Explanation for Emergent Abilities
evidence_items.explanation: This study shows how measurement choices can create apparent sudden capability jumps. It supports caution about emergence claims, but smooth improvement remains compatible with substantial gains and does not establish a capability ceiling.

unresolved_gaps: The claim supplies no baseline that distinguishes existing research capabilities from substantial further capabilities.
The strongest retrieved indications concern smaller-model improvements or predictions validated on already-existing models.

The available evidence does not establish an absence of credible signs, but treating these particular results as decisive contradiction requires an interpretation of significance and baseline that Zitron did not supply.
